Definition: Gilgal, the name of three places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Gilgal = "a wheel, rolling"; 1) the first site of an Israelite camp west of the Jordan, east of Jericho, here Samuel was judge, and Saul was made king; later used for illicit worship; 2) dwelling place of prophets in northern Israel about four miles (7 km) from Shiloh and Bethel; 3) a region conquered by Joshua, site unsure
